title: Verify: Remaining config keys load and cmd uses no removed key unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove the example config and defaults load and no source reads a removed key
description: Add tests proving REQ2 acceptance criteria using the example file, fstest and file reads of Go sources in a temp-free read-only way.
acceptance_criteria: Example config loads with expected values
No Go source under cmd or internal/server mentions worker config fields

steps.action: Add a test calling Load("../../configs/config.example.yaml"). Assert no error, Server.Addr is ":8080", Round.Duration is 24*time.Hour and Contribution.MaxPromptLen is 500.

Add a test loading 'auth:\n  token_secret: s\n' via LoadFS with a getenv returning ''. Assert Round.SchedulerInterval is 30*time.Second, Storage.ContentDir is "game/content" and Contribution.RateMax is 3.
Add a test that walks ../server and ../../cmd/server for *.go files (skipping removed_code_test.go), and fails if any contains cfg.Worker, WorkRoot, MaxBudget or AutoPublish.
